independent_read_only_review: No blocking source, model geometry, load, support, work, reaction or saved-face-gap inconsistency was found for the declared linear no-contact C1 reference.

clarifications.support_component_maximum: V1 reports the plate/root component maximum. Including the total support gives approximately 0.000718 at factor 2 and 0.001551 at factor 4, still below the registered 0.02 bound.
clarifications.open_faces: The positive continuous saved-field bound covers opposed top/underside faces only where their deformed XY regions overlap; it does not establish side clearance or contact admissibility.
clarifications.work: The reported work is the actual end-face nodal-force dot displacement. It differs from 100 times fitted tip rx minus 1000 times fitted tip uz by approximately 2.03e-5 J at factor 2 and 1.08e-5 J at factor 4.
clarifications.pose: The fitted 25-node solid section rotation differs from the bonded-face slope by 3.34 and 3.55 microradians at factors 2 and 4; maximum fitted-section warping residuals are 0.316 and 0.341 micrometres. A native rigid B3 tip rotation is not simultaneously both solid observables.

limits: Directional combined-load reference only. No side contact, three-level convergence, native-line accuracy, multiplier-space selection or G0B acceptance follows.
